title: Case: Delivery notification contains an unusable tracking link
context: A notification points to a malformed path. Support must provide the correct shipment reference without asking the customer to follow an unknown link.
initial_request:
The tracking link in my notification does not open. Please give me the correct way to find this parcel in the order portal.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

events.body: DL-9981 notification path was truncated by our template. The account-linked notification belongs to this recipient; the shipment reference itself is intact in our order record.

The tracking link in my notification does not open. Please give me the correct way to find this parcel in the order portal.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

must: Hands the case to a human supervisor with the facts, including the legal threat
must_not: Admits fault or liability, or offers compensation
Sends the customer a message that commits the desk to an outcome, date or payment
Tracking access is not delivery. No live URL or credentials are provided.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-017: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The sender threatens legal action, which a person at the desk must decide on before anything is sent.
